literal: To the dream that came with a message from my lover, what hospitality shall I indeed offer?
translation: What hospitality can I offer to the dream that came to me bearing a message from my beloved?
modern: என் காதலரின் தூதுடன் வந்த கனவுக்கு நான் என்ன விருந்து செய்வேன்?
explanation: The heroine, suffering from the pain of separation, experiences a dream in which her lover appears. She views this dream not just as an illusion, but as an honored guest that has traveled to bring her a precious message of love. Overwhelmed with gratitude, she wonders what fitting hospitality or feast (vīrundu) she can offer to welcome this dream. This highlights her deep longing and how even a fleeting dream of her lover is treated as a life-giving blessing.
